groups.rationale: Reviewed unchanged system sources against the shared reference update: current Elixir verification prerequisites and exact guest evidence alter no system ownership, topology, backups or recovery authority. The maintained domain and deployment inventories remain unchanged.

Reviewed Marshall test prerequisites and handbook refusal evidence: generated context properties retain their assertions in tagged tests, tuple generators and explicit unknown-ID filtering avoid pinned frontend defects, and qualified Hegel runners receive bounded lexical recognition with refusal regressions. Chapters17/19 distinguish the 28-test focused pass from incomplete full consumer gates; production APIs and domain authority are unchanged.

Reviewed unchanged protocol sources against chapters07/17/19: exact sealed FreeBSD qualification, native wire metadata, current launch codecs and capability refusals remain unchanged. New guest custody and direct-host evidence retain image-specific scope without adding OmniOS admission or a protocol execution claim.

Reviewed retained-bundle storage recognition: exact claim/spec/nonce/GUID/mount/drive/disk metadata and private bounded boot-file custody remain mandatory; invalid current bundle contents grant no credit and no readiness, launch, rewrite or cleanup authority. Chapter05 and scenario coverage record the passing disposable mirrored-ZFS fixture and preserve runtime, concurrency and physical-recovery gaps; current consumer test prerequisites retain refusal assertions.

Reviewed unchanged service application sources against shared guest/reference/coverage edits. Foreign-image packaging, Windows sealed publication and native transport evidence change no Audi/Brady/Ziggy/Galileo/Enrico/Porsche/Lyra service API, credential authority, execution fence or deployment role; native and live guest results retain explicit boundaries.

Reviewed deterministic foreign-Linux roots, explicit locked service identities and pinned SSH/PAM/sudo custody, sealed recursive Windows fleet selection, exact named native promotion oracles, illumos accept RESPONSE ordering and mirrored-ZFS retained-bundle fixture. Chapter07 records actual cross-host rootfs rebuilds, signed Windows custody and exact OmniOS direct-host results while preserving daemon-recovery, formal nested-KVM, native peer/physical and admission gaps. No host, service or Ash inventory additions.

Reviewed the explicit-image Porsche matrix runner, strict fixture ownership and SSH binding, durable accepted UUIDs and digest-only private receipts, plus 23 controlled tests and a recorded NixOS/Ubuntu/FreeBSD live create/SSH/stop/restart/cleanup subset. Matrix/capacity reviews, ADR evidence and chapters17/19 distinguish artifact custody, native execution and remaining seven-OS gaps. Qualified Elixir Hegel runner recognition preserves assertion/path/execution checks and has focused passing regressions.
